creativeDirection: A handcrafted shadow-box assemblage photographed like a surreal stage set, combining painted cut paper, stitched fabric, photo-collage, and miniature props.
scene: A straight-on view of a white brick wall with a deep arched niche built into it, like a tiny roadside shrine or cabinet of curiosities opened to reveal a strange musical altar.

elements.element: the main idol is a red devil-like figure with one purple bat wing, rendered as a glowing painted cutout standing inside the niche
two hugging girls appear as a pink-purple tinted devotional snapshot pinned to one inner side of the niche, with an orange floral patterned backing paper behind them
a large yellow flower with a black-and-white baby face and a ring of sprinkled candy forms a halo-like medallion above the idol
a glowing yellow orb hangs to the left inside the niche, while tiny cables, boxy machine parts, and a small dark suited figure cluster at the base as mechanical offerings
an upside-down shirtless performer is transformed into a black-and-white pasted snapshot tucked among floor cables and amplifier debris at the bottom of the shrine
four men thrusting fists forward become a worn sepia group photo pasted along the lower frame edge, like keepers or patrons of the shrine
the entire setting is constructed from a flat white brick wall, giving the assemblage a stark architectural surround
three men in sunglasses appear as a narrow monochrome placard mounted near the base, with a strip of tiny coloured rectangles beneath them like relic labels

coverSummaries.description: A brightly coloured surreal illustration shows a red devil-like humanoid figure standing upright in the center, with small horns and one visible purple bat wing. The figure is outlined by a glowing pale edge and appears against a blue, star-speckled cosmic oval. Around this central area are swirling, flame-like bands of yellow, orange, and red filling the frame.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: red devil-like figure with a purple wing

coverSummaries.description: A tinted photograph of two young girls closely embracing fills most of the cover. One girl looks slightly to the side while the other smiles toward the camera. At left is the back of a white chair. The upper portion has an orange field covered with a repeating floral or fan-like pattern, while the girls and lower area are rendered in pink and purple tones.
coverSummaries.medium: colour-tinted photograph with graphic patterned background

coverSummaries.description: A large yellow flower dominates the image, centered on a pale background. In the flower’s middle is a black-and-white baby’s face, surrounded by a ring of round candy-like balls covered in multicoloured sprinkles. The composition has a slightly aged, printed look with a thin dark border around the edge.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: baby face inside a yellow flower with sprinkled candy ring

coverSummaries.description: A dark space-themed illustration features a large glowing yellow planet or orb on the left and a starry black background. On the right, a red nude female figure floats or poses diagonally with hair streaming upward. Along the bottom are mechanical and electronic-looking devices in orange, black, red, and blue, including cables and boxy equipment. A dark, bulky suited figure appears near the lower left-center.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: floating red female figure in space

coverSummaries.description: A black-and-white live-performance photograph is inset within a wide red border. In the photo, a shirtless person is upside down in a handstand or dive-like pose on a cluttered floor covered with cables. In the background are another person standing, amplifiers, drum hardware, and a cramped indoor venue setting.
coverSummaries.medium: black-and-white concert photograph with coloured border

coverSummaries.description: A studio portrait shows four adult men grouped tightly together, facing the camera and thrusting their fists forward. Letters are written across their fingers and knuckles. One man at right is shirtless and wears shiny metallic trousers; the others wear dark or patterned clothing. The background is a plain brownish studio backdrop, and the image has a warm, slightly vintage tone.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: four men extending fists toward the camera

coverSummaries.description: A stark minimalist cover shows a flat white brick wall pattern filling the entire frame. Thin blue-grey lines define the rectangular bricks in horizontal rows. In the center is red hand-drawn lettering, the only strong contrasting element on the otherwise plain wall.

A high-contrast portrait on a white background shows three adult men from the chest up, all wearing dark sunglasses. The central figure faces forward, flanked by two others angled slightly inward. Above them is large black text, and along the bottom is a narrow strip of small rectangular images in various colours, like a filmstrip or collage of tiny photos.

prompt: Straight-on view of a white brick wall with a deep arched niche cut into it, like a small roadside shrine or cabinet of curiosities; at the center of the niche stands a glowing red devil-like humanoid with small horns and one visible purple bat wing, treated as the main idol and given the clearest scale and focus; above it hangs a large yellow flower medallion with a black-and-white baby face in the center, encircled by round candy-like beads covered in multicoloured sprinkles, functioning as a halo, while to the left a luminous yellow planet-like orb hovers and along the niche floor sit miniature cables, boxy electronic devices, and a small dark bulky suited figure as offerings; on one inner wall of the niche, pin a pink-and-purple tinted snapshot of two young girls embracing against orange patterned paper, intimate but secondary; near the bottom among coiled cables and amplifier fragments, tuck a black-and-white pasted image of an upside-down shirtless performer; along the lower frame edge paste a worn sepia studio photo of four men thrusting their fists toward the viewer, and add a small monochrome placard of three men in dark sunglasses with a narrow strip of tiny coloured rectangles beneath it; handcrafted shadow-box assemblage, photographed as a real constructed object, using painted cut paper, stitched fabric, aged photo-collage, miniature props, scuffed cardboard, and layered matte textures; strong central hierarchy with the red winged figure and flower halo dominant, supporting relics arranged asymmetrically around it, crisp frontal composition, shallow cabinet depth, soft theatrical spotlight inside the niche and dimmer ambient light on the brick surround; palette of chalk white, glowing yellow, sulfur orange, crimson red, magenta purple, deep black, and faded sepia, with a playful ritualistic uncanny mood. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
